description.value: The columnar growth that makes the canopy forest of the carbon world, rising to ninety metres without a branch and carrying its entire photosynthetic surface in the top fifteen. Everything the canopy people build is cut from it, and a house holds a named block of columns as an estate rather than as timber. A felled column takes about two hundred years to replace and the cutting rota is accordingly the most closely watched schedule on the planet.
